scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "CLIENT,SERVER,DIFFUSION" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:diffusion"
scripts.dev:diffusion: cd server/diffusion-service && conda run -n project uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.setup:diffusion: cd server/diffusion-service && conda run -n project pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:client && npm run install:server && npm run setup:diffusion
scripts.clean: npm run clean:client && npm run clean:server
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx knex migrate:latest --knexfile knexfile.ts
scripts.db:rollback: cd server && npx knex migrate:rollback --knexfile knexfile.ts
